title: Voice/video note send registers its draft clear under the open chat's slot, not the target chat's, overwriting that slot's own clear
trigger: Tap Send on a voice note in chat A with a caption, open chat B at once, and send a text in B before A's encode ends: send_finished_voice calls expect_draft_clear, which inserts into B's slot (set_draft_clear replaces the entry); with no chat open the clear is dropped
effect: B's text draft is not cleared on its ack and comes back as a draft (or A's caption draft reappears when no chat was open): the same text can be sent twice
fix: expect_draft_clear takes the SendSlot the send was fixed on (SendTarget holds the slot), never send_slot() at landing

title: Same wrong-slot draft clear for the finished round video
trigger: Tap Send on a round video, switch chats before ffmpeg finishes the file
effect: the open chat's pending clear is replaced by the video's; a clear can be dropped when no chat is open
fix: SendTarget carries its SendSlot; set_draft_clear(target slot, ...)

title: Change-password form with an empty new password turns two-step verification off
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Two-step verification > Change password: type the current password, leave New password empty, press Change. submit_twofa_password(include_email=false) only requires the current password; set_two_step_password maps an empty new password to PasswordOp::DisablePassword.
effect: The account's cloud password is removed although the user asked to change it; the view returns to Status showing it Off and the typed current password is cleared. No confirmation or error.
fix: Make the form a TwofaForm enum (Enable/Change/Disable/Email) whose Change variant requires a non-empty new password, and let only Disable send an empty one.

title: Two-step forms share their input entities, so Turn off can send a hidden new password
trigger: Open the Change form, type a current and a new password, press Back, open Turn off, retype only the current password, press Turn off. goto_twofa_view only clears the flow notice; new_password, hint and email entities keep their text and are read by the same submit_twofa_password.
effect: Turn off sends setPassword with the stale hidden new password and hint, so the cloud password is changed to a value the user cannot see instead of being removed. Email and Recover forms leak the same way.
fix: A TwofaForm enum whose variant owns its own inputs (built on entering the view and dropped on leaving), so a form can only read the fields it shows.

title: Selection owner table is cleared at 50,000 entries, mid-selection, and never pruned otherwise
trigger: Scroll a very long history so more than 50,000 text handles have painted (each new row makes a new TextSelectionHandle), with a drag selection under way.
effect: OWNERS (entity id to bare (chat, message)) is a thread-local with no owner: it is only cleared wholesale. After the clear the anchor's message is unknown, so rows of other messages stop being treated as foreign and one copy can join text of several messages; the entries are also bare chat ids, not account keys.
fix: Keep the message key in the text handle's own element state, or in a map owned by the WindowSlot that drops entries with their rows.

title: A photo check that lands after its 15s give-up leaves its JPEG on disk
trigger: Attach a large HEIC/JXL photo whose decode takes over 15 seconds; the give-up timer settles the read as FileOnly, then the worker finishes and writes a JPEG into quill-send-photos.
effect: finish_media_check returns early on the stale job and drops MediaCheck::Jpeg(path) without removing the file, so each late result leaves a temp JPEG until the scratch dir is cleaned.
fix: Remove the Jpeg file when finish() reports a stale job (as video_preview does), or have the stage own the file.

title: Send box tile buttons act on a tray index, not on the attachment they were drawn for
trigger: Press Remove, Spoiler or Edit on a tile in one window while another window of the same chat removes or adds an attachment between that frame and the click.
effect: remove_attachment(index), toggle_attachment_spoiler(index) and edit_send_card_item(index) read the current tray at click time, so a shifted index acts on the neighbouring file. (pick_attachment_cover already uses a TrayItem.)
fix: Key every tile action by TrayItem (slot plus path), as pick_attachment_cover does.

title: SettingsSearch::stage Finished is a one-shot reset marker that only the next render consumes
trigger: close_settings() sets stage = Finished; settle_settings_search (run from settings_window render) is the only reader and turns it back into Live by clearing the input.
effect: No bug today: the next open renders and settles before the field is read. The enum is a two-state flag beside the input text it stands for, set from outside its own transitions.
fix: Have close_settings() clear the input directly (it has no Window, so queue a Farewell step), and make stage just the selected row.

title: Hovering a gallery row re-asks for its menu actions on every hover until an answer lands
trigger: Move the pointer on and off a Files/Media row several times before the first getMessageProperties answer arrives, or on a row whose answer never comes (message deleted).
effect: Each hover-in with no cached actions sends another getMessageProperties; nothing records that one is in flight, so a row whose answer never lands asks again on every hover.
fix: Hold a Fetch<MessageActions> per (chat, message) so a hover asks only while Idle.
